reference_scope.profile: H09 community arrays are only explicit reference pools; H05 cost and stats are client facts, not live eligibility
reference_scope.input: each successful summon consumes one caller-supplied index into the fixed H09 array with grade reference_injected; full-board requests draw nothing
reference_scope.supported_candidates: only the listed no-combat-action subsets execute; all other pool indexes reject the entire strike without selecting a substitute
reference_scope.form: normal candidate entity is created even when the source is golden; this is a reference decision
reference_scope.position: insert sequentially at the dead source's former index, limited to seven friendly units
reference_scope.repeats: one surviving Baron repeats the source deathrattle two or three times; a Khadgar interaction rejects
reference_scope.generated_manifest: new combat_generated_minion instances use the original source and reference_injected pool grade, then enter terminal damage settlement
reference_scope.same_batch: two compiled random-summon sources dying in the same batch reject atomically
